origin.description: Return the version of the time zone database currently in use.
origin.details: The version is the first token of the version file in the text database.
origin.value: A single string of the database version.

translation.description: Return the version string of the text time zone database.
translation.details: Reads the first token of the version file. For tzdb 0.5.0 that token is 2025a.
